ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name RentRoute (RentRoute Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.rentroute.example
Location Bengaluru, Karnataka
Incorporated May 2026
One-line description App to pay rent by credit card.
Sector (as selected) Fintech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 4 (2 founders, 2 contract developers)
Founders
Founder 1 Sameer Qureshi, CEO. Product manager at a fintech for 4 years;
launched two payments features. linkedin.com/in/sameer-qureshi-
example
Founder 2 Divya Menon, Growth. 5 years in consumer marketing.
linkedin.com/in/divya-menon-example
Time commitment Sameer full-time since June 2026. Divya full-time since August 2026.
Prior startup experience None.
Equity split Founders 100%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A mobile app that lets users pay rent by credit card. We pay the
landlord's bank account through a payment aggregator partner.
Users 1,900 registered. 1,100 have paid at least once.
Rent volume INR 6.1 Cr paid since July 2026 across 2,400 payments.
Revenue Users pay a 1.8% fee: INR 11 L gross. After the 0.9% we pay the
payment partner, net revenue is INR 5.5 L.
Customer acquisition Mostly organic and word of mouth. In small paid tests we saw about
INR 120 per registered user. We have not measured cost per paying
user.
Dependencies We rely on a single payment aggregator partner. Banks and card
networks have changed rules on rent payments before, and a change
would hit us directly.

Fundraising
Amount raising INR 1.8 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 12 Cr post-money
Existing investors None. Founders have put in INR 18 L of savings.
Use of funds Marketing, engineering, operations.
Other investors in
conversation
None.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We believe rent is a large, underserved payment category.
